out_of_schema_notes: The six findings, the root cause, the contributing causes and the effectiveness check have no schema model; they are report_sections statements. Each corrective and preventive action and each plan approval date is a statement anchored on its own row.

acceptance_criteria holds the criteria-change table of §3.3: every Version 1.0 step criterion as superseded and every Version 2.0 criterion as in force. The Version 1.0 rule (R1 to R4) and, for R1, its safety factor are in the record basis or the assertions anchored on the safety-factor table.

The capability records are simulated values the investigation reports: the Version 2.0 two-sided index for acidic variants, and two Version 1.0 values it corrects (the one-sided acidic variant index and the MVM minimum PCMR-001 Version 1.0 reported).

The S-CEX-FRC method comparability replicates and the worst-case verification table are not represented row by row; the verification is a statement. The size-variant methods table anchors the SEC and nrCE-SDS method records on the rows that name each method and occur once in the document.

The only study of a schema type is S-PA-SDM2, the supplementary qualification of DEV-005-03 that ran during the investigation. No parameters and no CQA register of its own. No rhetorical_spans (none were curated). weak_claims is empty.
